text:
tess: Found a weird edge: some old API keys are hitting our routing layer with project_id=null and still getting routed to project pools. Might be causing billing noise.
omar: Are those the keys minted before project scoping? We did a best-effort backfill last year but not exhaustive.
rui: Yup, pre-scoped keys. Router checks project header first, falls back to key lookup. If key lookup returns no project we currently return org fallback, but the console tag is empty.
zoe: For dashboards this shows up as "(unassigned)" which breaks per-project cost breakdowns and quota charts.
tess: Two options: 1) conservative: treat null as org-only and exclude from project charts, 2) aggressive: auto-assign to org-default project and backfill historical telemetry.
omar: I prefer option 1 initially. Less surprising for customers. But we should give a migration API and bulk tool for org admins.
rui: Implementation notes: add key.project_assignment_state enum {UNASSIGNED, AUTO_ASSIGNED, USER_ASSIGNED} and add attrib_version on usage events. That way we can keep historical rows immutable.
zoe: UX: surface assignment state next to key name, but never show raw key. Provide an "Assign" button that opens a modal with a dropdown of projects plus a dry-run preview.
tess: Quotas: unassigned -> enforce org-level quota only. If we auto-assign later, do not retro-apply project quota blocks. Otherwise customers will get sudden failures.
omar: Agreed. Also policy for auto-assign: send 21d notice then auto-assign to org-default, unless org has opted out.
ops-bot: prod-alert: key-attr-backfill job failing on staging with 2.1% mismatch threshold exceeded. Investigate.
rui: For telemetry pipeline change we'll add attrib_version and a migration table mapping key->(project,version,timestamp). Dashboards will be updated to optionally include versioned view.
zoe: Add two dashboard filters: "show unassigned" and "use migrated attribution". Default should be conservative: exclude migrated auto-assigned from project totals unless admin opts in.
tess: API endpoints: POST /orgs/:org/keys/bulk_assign (dry_run=true|false), PATCH /keys/:id/assign (reason, source=AUTO|MANUAL, dry_run). Both create audit events.
omar: Need ACL: only org admins or service accounts with project-admin scope can assign. Add an oauth scope change for the console flow.
rui: Devops note: backfill will touch large time-series. We'll do incremental epochs and compare sums at each step. Add an alert if token counts differ by >0.5%.
zoe: I'll mock the console copy. Keep wording neutral and include links to docs explaining billing impact.
tess: Small perf thought: adding enum to event envelope increases size slightly. Use integer codes and name table in schema to minimize bytes.
omar: Who will own rollout? rui + zoe for pipeline + UX. I'll coordinate communications with CS.
ops-bot: rollout plan: staged rollout to 10% orgs on 2025-04-01, bump after 48h if error rate <0.1% and backfill mismatch <0.5%.
tess: Cool. I'll open tickets: ENG-assign-migration and ENG-console-assign-workflow and link here.
